title: Joe Burrow has no thoughts about the LSU, Jayden Daniels number fracas

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joe Burrow has no thoughts about the LSU, Jayden Daniels number fracas
sources.description: The sudden and surprising scuffle between Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels and LSU over the re-issuance of his number (5) has implicated Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow, given that the school has to date honored its vow to not use his number (9) again.
